parsed.post: Kept the improvement from DEPTH=6, WARMUP=0.1, and WD=0.01 (val_bpb 1.0084). It seems increasing model capacity and stabilizing with warmup/weight decay is working. Next, I'll test increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if further width/capacity scaling helps, while avoiding the potential shard 10 leakage others mentioned.
parsed.description: Increase ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to further increase model capacity/width, building on the successful DEPTH=6 configuration.
